/*****************************************
Reset.css
******************************************/
* {
padding: 0;
margin: 0;
outline: 0;
border: 0;
box-sizing: border-box;
}
html {
height: auto;
overflow: auto;
}
a, input, button {
transition: .4s all ease;
}
a {
text-decoration: none;
color: #fff;
}
body .section, body .section .widget, body .section .widget-content {
margin: 0;
padding: 0;
}
body {
color: #fff;
background-color: #06131c;
position: relative;
display: block;
overflow: hidden;
font-size: 16px;
font-weight: 400;
font-style: normal;
font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;
}
img {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
object-fit: cover;
object-position: center;
vertical-align: middle;
}
em {
font-style: normal;
}
li {
list-style: none;
}
input {
overflow: hidden;
font-size: 16px;
font-weight: 400;
font-style: normal;
font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;
background-color: transparent;
color: #fff;
position: relative;
width: 100%;
caret-color: var(--color);
}
button {
cursor: pointer;
border: 0;
outline: 0;
background-color: transparent;
color: #fff;
font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;
font-size: 16px;
font-weight: 400;
font-style: normal;
overflow: hidden;
}
.post-footer {
display: none;
}
div#blog-pager {
display: none;
}
body div .section, body div .section .widget, body div .section .widget-content, body div .section .widget-content ul, body div .section .widget-content ul li, body div .section form, body div .section td, body div .section tr, body div .section tbody, body div .section thead, body div .section th {

}
body .section {

padding: 0;
}
body {
padding-top: 80px;
}
/*****************************************
Header.css
******************************************/
.header {
position: fixed;
top: 0;
right: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 80px;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
transition: .4s all ease;
z-index: 999999;
background-color: #1b252f;
color: #fff;
background-image: linear-gradient(to left, transparent, #1b252f, transparent);
background: var(--color);
}
.header-menu .widget-content>ul>li>a {
border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.header-menu .widget-content>ul>li:hover>a {
background-color: #0c1821;
border: 1px solid #00000085;
border-bottom: 0;
border-top: 0;
}
.header {
box-shadow: 0 3px 3px #0000003d;
}
.container {
width: 100%;
max-width: 100%;
padding-right: 1.5rem;
padding-left: 1.5rem;
margin-right: auto;
margin-left: auto;
}
.header-inner {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
position: relative;
transition: .4s all ease;
width: 100%;
}
.header-logo img {
width: 120px;
}
.header-actions {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
gap: 10px;
margin-right: auto;
position: relative;
transition: .4s all ease;
}
.header-menu .widget-content>ul ul.sub-menu {
position: absolute;
top: 100%;
right: 0;
opacity: 0;
visibility: hidden;
transition: .4s all ease;
}
.header-login:hover {
background-color: #4CAF50;
}
.header-login, .menu-button {
background-color: #474c5259;
position: relative;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
border-radius: 5px;
overflow: hidden;
font-size: 14px;
font-weight: 600;
padding-right: 1rem;
padding-left: 1rem;
height: 35px;
border-width: 1px;
border-style: solid;
border-color: #ffffff05;
}
.header-actions em {
display: flex;
height: 15px;
width: 1px;
background-color: #06131c14;
transition: .4s all ease;
overflow: hidden;
border-radius: 50px;
position: relative;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
}
.header-bell svg, .header-playlist svg, .search-button svg {
height: auto;
width: 17px;
}
.header-bell, .header-playlist, .search-button {
border-width: 1px;
border-style: solid;
border-color: #ffffff05;
height: 35px;
width: 35px;

border-width: 1px;
border-style: solid;
border-color: #1b252f;
}
.single-actor-info {
border-radius: 1rem;
padding: 1rem;
background-color: #0c1821;
padding-top: 2.3rem;
}
.single-actor-name {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
position: relative;
transition: .4s all ease;
border-radius: 50px;
padding-right: 1rem;
padding-left: 1rem;
overflow: hidden;
height: 26px;
background-color: #ffffff0d;
}
.single-actor-nickname {
font-size: 12px;
font-weight: 700;
color: #b7c9ef;
text-transform: uppercase;
margin-top: 5px;
}
.block {
width: 258px;
height: auto;
border-radius: 20px;
overflow: hidden;
position: relative;
transition: .35s ease;
border-width: 3px;
border-style: dashed;
border-color: #ffffff0a;
background-color: #0c1821;
padding-bottom: 23%;
}
.block:before {
content: '';
position: absolute;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
background: linear-gradient(to top, #0c1821, transparent);
right: 0;
top: 0;
z-index: 1;
}
.block-preview {
position: absolute;
overflow: hidden;
perspective: 500px;
display: block;
top: 0;
right: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
}
.block:hover .block-preview-image {
transform: rotateY(-90deg);
}
.block-preview-image {
display: block;
object-fit: cover;
background-size: 100% 100%;
background-position: center;
transition: .35s linear;
z-index: 99;
transform-origin: right;
border-radius: 17px;
overflow: hidden;
box-shadow: inset 0 0 25px #ffffff36;
position: absolute;
top: 0;
right: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
}
.block:hover .over-layer {
transform: rotateY(0deg);
opacity: 1;
}
.over-layer {
position: absolute;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
left: 0;
top: 0;
text-align: center;
transform: rotateY(90deg);
transition: .35s linear;
z-index: 999999999999;
transform-origin: left;
opacity: 0;
}
.block-preview-hover {
display: block;
object-fit: cover;
background-size: 100% 100%;
background-position: center;
transition: .35s linear;
z-index: 99;
transform-origin: right;
border-radius: 17px;
overflow: hidden;
box-shadow: inset 0 0 25px #ffffff36;
position: absolute;
top: 0;
right: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
}
.block:hover .block-retitle {
opacity: 0;
visibility: hidden;
}
.block-retitle {
position: absolute;
bottom: 0;
z-index: 99;
font-size: 12px;
color: #fff;
text-shadow: -2px 3px 4px #01041a;
transition: .4s all ease;
width: 100%;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
padding: 1.5rem;
}
.block-link {
display: table-cell;
vertical-align: middle;
}
.block-title {
position: relative;
width: 100%;
margin: 0 auto;
padding: 0;
text-align: center;
font-size: 14px;
font-weight: 600;
}
.block:hover .block-label {
visibility: hidden;
opacity: 0;
transform: scale(0);
}
.block-label {
position: absolute;
top: 10px;
left: 10px;
width: 60px;
z-index: 9;
transition: .4s all ease;
}
.block-label a {
color: #fff;
display: inline-block;
width: 100%;
margin: 0;
margin-bottom: 3px;
position: relative;
text-align: center;
border-radius: 5px;
padding: 0;
}
.block-label-year {
background-color: var(--color);
}
.block-label-quality {
background-color: #fff;
}
.block .block-label-quality {
color:#000;
}
.block:hover .block-info {
transform: rotateY(0deg);
opacity: 1;
}
.block-info {
display: block;
position: absolute;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
right: 0;
top: 0;
text-align: center;
transform: rotateY(90deg);
transition: .35s linear;
transform-origin: left;
opacity: 0;
padding: 10px;
margin: 0;
background: #0c18217d;
color: #fff;
z-index: 9;
}
.block:hover .block-info>.block-info-title {
transform: translate(0);
}
.block-info>.block-info-title {
position: relative;
display: block;
color: #cacac9;
margin: 0;
margin-bottom: 10px;
line-height: inherit;
font-family: 'Almarai', sans-serif;
font-weight: 600;
transition: .35s ease;
font-size: 13px;
transform: translateY(-120%);
}
.block-info>.block-info-title>.block-info-title {
position: relative;
width: 100%;
margin: 0 auto;
padding: 0;
text-align: center;
font-size: 14px;
font-weight: 600;
}
.block-list {
padding: 0 !important;
margin: 0 !important;
}
.block-item {
margin: 0 !important;
padding: 4px !important;
text-align: right;
border-bottom: 1px solid #ffffff24;
font-size: 13px;
transition: .35s ease;
opacity: 0;
transform: translateY(25px);
transition-delay: .45s;
width: 100%;
display: block;
color: #fff;
}
.block:hover .block-list .block-item {
opacity: 1;
transform: translate(0);
}
.block-item:nth-child(1) {
transition-delay: .45s;
}
.block-item:nth-child(2) {
transition-delay: .50s;
}
.block-item:nth-child(3) {
transition-delay: .55s;
}
.block-item:nth-child(4) {
transition-delay: .60s;
}
.single-grid {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
flex-wrap: wrap;
flex-direction: row;
transition: .4s all ease;
gap: 15px;
}
.block:hover:after {
transform: scale(220);
opacity: 0;
transition: .5s all ease;
}
.single-grid .block:hover .block-preview:nth-child(1) {
opacity: 1;
visibility: visible;
}
.single-grid .block .block-preview:nth-child(1) {
position: absolute;
top: auto;
right: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 50%;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
transition: .4s all ease;
z-index: 10;
bottom: 0;
opacity: 0;
visibility: hidden;
}
.block:after {
width: 5px;
height: 5px;
border-radius: 50%;
content: '';
position: absolute;
top: 50%;
pointer-events: none;
right: 50%;
margin: -2.5px;
background: #ffffff82;
transform: scale(0);
}
/*****************************************
Menu App.css
******************************************/
.menu-mobile {
position: fixed;
bottom: 0;
right: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 70px;
display: none;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
transition: .4s all ease;
overflow: hidden;
background-color: #06131cc2;
backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
z-index:99999;
}
.menu-mobile ul {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: space-between;
text-align: center;
width: 100%;
position: relative;
transition: .4s all ease;
}
.menu-mobile ul a {
position: relative;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;

overflow: hidden;
}
.menu-mobile ul a:before {

text-align: center;
transition: .4s all ease;
overflow: hidden;
background-color: var(--color);
content: '';
margin-right: auto;
margin-left: auto;
opacity: 0;
visibility: hidden;
}
/*****************************************
Slider.css
******************************************/
.slider .container {
max-width: 100%;
width: 100%;
padding: 0;
}
.slider .owl-stage-outer .owl-item>div * {
border-radius: 0;
}
.slider .owl-stage-outer .owl-item>div {
padding-bottom: 150%;
border-radius: 0;
border: 0;
}
.slider .owl-stage-outer .owl-item>div {
width: 100%;
}
.slider {
width: 100%;
position: relative;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
overflow: hidden;
transition: .4s all ease;
padding-bottom: 0;
background-image: linear-gradient(to right, #06131C, #1A242E);
}
.slider .owl-carousel .owl-nav {
display: flex !important;
}
.slider .owl-carousel .owl-nav button.owl-prev {
position: absolute;
top: 0;
left: 0;
width: 15%;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
height: 100%;
background-image: linear-gradient(to right, #06131c, transparent);
font-size: 60px;
color: #fff;
transition: .4s all ease;
}
.slider .owl-carousel .owl-nav .owl-next {
position: absolute;
top: 0;
right: 0;
width: 15%;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
height: 100%;
background-image: linear-gradient(to left, #06131c, transparent);
font-size: 60px;
color: #fff;
transition: .4s all ease;
}
.slider .owl-carousel .owl-nav button:hover {
color: #fff;
}
.slider .owl-dots button.owl-dot.active {
width: 25px;
border-radius: 50px;
background-color: var(--color);
}
.slider .owl-dots button.owl-dot {
width: 6px;
height: 6px;
background-color: #1a242e;
border-radius: 50%;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
position: relative;
transition: .4s all ease;
}
.slider .owl-dots span {
display: none;
}
.slider .owl-dots {
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
gap: 5px;
}
.slider .owl-dots {
margin-top: 1rem;
}
.slider .owl-carousel .owl-nav button span:hover {
color: var(--color);
}
.slider .owl-carousel .owl-nav button.owl-prev span {
position: relative;
right: 80px;
opacity: 0;
visibility: hidden;
transition: .4s all ease;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
}
.slider .owl-carousel .owl-nav button.owl-next span {
position: relative;
left: 80px;
opacity: 0;
visibility: hidden;
transition: .4s all ease;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
}
.slider:hover .owl-carousel .owl-nav button span {
opacity: 1;
visibility: visible;
}

/*****************************************
News Ticker.css
******************************************/
.news-ticker-wrapper {
background: #19262f;
overflow: hidden;
direction: rtl;
padding: 1rem 0;
border-bottom: 2px solid #19262f;
display: flex; /* لضمان استقامة الحاوية */
}
.news-ticker-container {
display: flex;
white-space: nowrap;
/* زدنا الوقت لـ 60 ثانية ليكون أبطأ وأكثر راحة للعين */
animation: ticker-move 60s linear infinite;
padding-left: 0;
}
.news-ticker-container:hover {
animation-play-state: paused;
}
.news-link {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
text-decoration: none;
color: #fff;
padding-left: 50px; /* المسافة من جهة اليسار لأن الاتجاه RTL */
flex-shrink: 0; /* يمنع انضغاط العناصر */
}
.news-title {
font-size: 14px;
margin: 0 10px;
font-weight: 500;
}
.news-icon {
color: #D92321;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
}
.news-ticker {
position: relative;
}
.svg-left {
position: absolute;
top: 100%;
height: 16px;
fill: #19262f;
background-size: contain;
background-repeat: no-repeat;
background-position: left;
width: 100%;
left: 0;
transition: .4s all ease;
}
.svg-right {
position: absolute;
bottom: 100%;
height: 160px;
fill: #19262f;
}
.svg-right path {
fill: #18252e;
}
.news-icon svg {
stroke: #fff;
opacity: .5;
}

/*****************************************
Categories.css
******************************************/
.categories-section ul {

align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
position: relative;
transition: .4s all ease;

.categories-section ul a:hover {

/*****************************************
Block Image.css
******************************************/
.block-image {
height: auto;
border-radius: 20px;
overflow: hidden;
position: relative;
transition: .35s ease;
border-width: 3px;
border-style: dashed;
border-color: #ffffff0a;
background-color: #0c1821;
padding-bottom: 130%;
width: 100%;
}
.block-image:before {
content: '';
position: absolute;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
background: linear-gradient(to top, #0c1821, transparent);
right: 0;
top: 0;
z-index: 1;
}
.block-image:after {
width: 5px;
height: 5px;
border-radius: 50%;
content: '';
position: absolute;
top: 50%;
pointer-events: none;
right: 50%;
margin: -2.5px;
background: #ffffff82;
transform: scale(0);
}
.block-image:hover:after {
transform: scale(220);
opacity: 0;
transition: .5s all ease;
}
.thumb {
position: absolute;
overflow: hidden;
perspective: 500px;
display: block;
top: 0;
right: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
}
.Half1 {
display: block;
object-fit: cover;
background-size: 100% 100%;
background-position: center;
transition: .35s linear;
z-index: 99;
transform-origin: right;
border-radius: 17px;
overflow: hidden;
box-shadow: inset 0 0 25px #ffffff36;
position: absolute;
top: 0;
right: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
}
.block-image:hover .Half1 {
transform: rotateY(-90deg);
}
.thumb-hover {
position: absolute;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
left: 0;
top: 0;
text-align: center;
transform: rotateY(90deg);
transition: .35s linear;
z-index: 999999999999;
transform-origin: left;
opacity: 0;
}
.block-image:hover .thumb-hover {
transform: rotateY(0deg);
opacity: 1;
}
.Half2 {
display: block;
object-fit: cover;
background-size: 100% 100%;
background-position: center;
transition: .35s linear;
z-index: 99;
transform-origin: right;
border-radius: 17px;
overflow: hidden;
box-shadow: inset 0 0 25px #ffffff36;
position: absolute;
top: 0;
right: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
}
.block-image:hover .retitle {
opacity: 0;
visibility: hidden;
}
.retitle {
position: absolute;
bottom: 0;
z-index: 99;
font-size: 12px;
color: #fff;
text-shadow: -2px 3px 4px #01041a;
transition: .4s all ease;
width: 100%;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
padding: 1.5rem;
}
.block-image .entry-title {
position: relative;
width: 100%;
margin: 0 auto;
padding: 0;
text-align: center;
font-size: 14px;
font-weight: 600;
}
.ias_trigger a:hover {
background-color: var(--color);
}
.ias_trigger a {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
position: relative;
transition: .4s all ease;
overflow: hidden;
border-radius: 5px;
height: 45px;
background-color: #1a242e;
padding-right: 1.5rem;
padding-left: 1.5rem;
border-width: 1px;
border-style: solid;
border-color: transparent;
}
.ias_trigger {
position: absolute;
bottom: 0;
right: 0;
left: 0;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
transition: .4s all ease;
}
.ias_loader {
position: absolute;
bottom: 0;
right: 0;
width: 100%;
height: auto;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
transition: .4s all ease;
}
.block-image-top {
position: absolute;
top: 10px;
left: 10px;
width: 60px;
z-index: 9;
transition: .4s all ease;
}
.block-image-link {
display: inline-block;
width: 100%;
margin: 0;
margin-bottom: 3px;
position: relative;
text-align: center;
border-radius: 5px;
padding: 0;
}
#block-image-year {
background-color: var(--color);
}
#block-image-quality {
background-color: #fff;
color: #000;
}
.block-image:hover .block-image-top {
visibility: hidden;
opacity: 0;
transform: scale(0);
}
.block-image:hover .block-image-details .post-title {
transform: translate(0);
}
.block-image-details .post-title {
position: relative;
display: block;
color: #cacac9;
margin: 0;
margin-bottom: 10px;
line-height: inherit;
font-family: 'Almarai', sans-serif;
font-weight: 600;
transition: .35s ease;
font-size: 13px;
transform: translateY(-120%);
}
.block-image:hover .block-image-details {
transform: rotateY(0deg);
opacity: 1;
}
.block-image-details {
display: block;
position: absolute;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
right: 0;
top: 0;
text-align: center;
transform: rotateY(90deg);
transition: .35s linear;
transform-origin: left;
opacity: 0;
padding: 10px;
margin: 0;
background: #0c18217d;
color: #fff;
z-index: 9;
}
.block-image-details .block-image-list {
padding: 0;
margin: 0;
}
.block-image-details .block-image-list .block-image-item {
margin: 0 !important;
padding: 4px !important;
text-align: right;
border-bottom: 1px solid #ffffff24;
font-size: 13px;
transition: .35s ease;
opacity: 0;
transform: translateY(25px);
transition-delay: .45s;
width: 100%;
display: block;
color: #fff;
}
.block-image:hover .block-image-list .block-image-item{
opacity: 1;
transform: translate(0);
}
.block-image-details .block-image-list .block-image-item:nth-child(1) {
transition-delay: .45s;
}
.block-image-details .block-image-list .block-image-item:nth-child(2) {
transition-delay: .50s;
}
.block-image-details .block-image-list .block-image-item:nth-child(3) {
transition-delay: .55s;
}
.block-image-details .block-image-list .block-image-item:nth-child(4) {
transition-delay: .60s;
}
.block-image-details .block-image-list .block-image-item .block-image-link {
width: auto;
}
.thumb-full-hover {
position: absolute;

}
.MpaaSwitch {
margin-top: 7px;
float: right;
cursor: pointer;
margin-left: 0px;
transition: .15s all ease;
height: 55px;
background: transparent;
user-select: none;
border-radius: 4px;
position: relative;
padding: 3px 12px 3px 96px;
}
.MpaaSwitch>span {
display: inline-block;
font-size: 16px;
font-weight: bold;
vertical-align: middle;
padding-top: 7px;
line-height: 100%;
margin-bottom: 5px;
color: #d4d6fb;
}
.MpaaSwitchInner {
height: 30px;
background: #1a242e;
display: inline-block;
border-radius: 50px;
padding: 5px;
width: 70px;
vertical-align: middle;
position: absolute;
top: 50%;
transition: .2s all ease;
left: 9px;
transform: translate(0, -50%);
}
.MpaaSwitchInner span {
display: block;
width: 20px;
height: 20px;
background: var(--color);
border-radius: 50%;
transition: .2s all ease;
}
.MpaaSwitch>p {
line-height: 100%;
font-size: 12px;
color: #9db7a1;
position: relative;
}
.MpaaSwitch>p:hover:after, .MpaaSwitch>p:hover:before {
visibility: visible;
opacity: 1;
}
.MpaaSwitch>p:before {
width: 0;
height: 0;
border-style: solid;
border-width: 8px 7px 8px 0;
border-color: #0000 #4c7b53 #0000 #0000;
content: '';
transition: .3s all ease;
position: absolute;
left: 100%;
margin-left: 4px;
top: 50%;
transform: translate(0, -50%);
visibility: hidden;
opacity: 0;
}
.MpaaSwitch>p:after {
content: Attr(data-tooltip);
position: absolute;
bottom: 50%;
left: 100%;
transition: .3s all ease;
background: #4c7b53;
width: 250px;
visibility: hidden;
opacity: 0;
transform: translate(0, 50%);
padding: 12px;
pointer-events: none;
line-height: 20px;
font-size: 13px;
border-radius: 4px;
color: #ffffff;
margin-left: 11px;
}

width: 1000px;
border-radius: 15px;
overflow: hidden;
margin-right: auto;
margin-left: auto;
transition: .4s all ease;
border-width: 1px;
border-style: solid;
border-color: #131E27;
}
.single-trailer-wrap iframe {
position: absolute;
top: 0;
right: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
transition: .4s all ease;
overflow: hidden;
}
.single-trailer-inner {
position: relative;
transition: .4s all ease;
transform: translate(0px, -100px);
opacity: 0;
visibility: hidden;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
overflow: hidden;
transition-delay: .45s;
}
.single-trailer.active {
opacity: 1;
visibility: visible;
}
.single-trailer.active .overlay {
opacity: 1;
visibility: visible;
}
.single-trailer.active .single-trailer-inner {
opacity: 1;
visibility: visible;
transform: translate(0);
}
.single-trailer-close:hover {
background-color: var(--color);
color: #fff;
}
.single-trailer-close {
position: absolute;
top: 0;
left: 0;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
border-radius: 50px;
background-color: #fff;
color: #000;
width: 50px;
height: 50px;
font-size: 20px;
transition: .4s all ease;
}
.single-trailer-close {
top: -4rem;
overflow: visible;
}
.single-trailer-inner {
overflow: visible;
}
.single-trailer-wrap {
overflow: visible;
}
/*****************************************
Animation.css
******************************************/
@keyframes ticker-move {
0% {transform: translateX(0);}
100% {transform: translateX(50%);}
}
/*****************************************
Root.css
******************************************/
:root {
--color:#D92321;
}

<h3 class="single-label-head">Avatar: The Way of Water ( 2022 )</h3>
</div>
</div>
<p class="single-description">مشاهدة وتحميل فيلم Avatar: The Way of Water 2022 مترجم بجودة عالية مشاهدة اون لاين وتحميل مباشر عبر موقع Moov</p>
<div class="single-group">
<h4 class="single-subtitle"><i class="fa-solid fa-quote-right"></i> قصة العرض</h4>
<p class="single-story">يحاول كل من جيك سولي ونيتيري أن يقوما بكل ما في وسعهما كي يظل مع&#1611;ا&#1548; ولكن يتحتم عليهما مفارقة منزلهما واكتشاف أرجاء شتى على كوكب باندورا لينهيا ما بدآه.</p>

<script type='text/javascript'>
/*<![CDATA[*/
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
const menuItems = document.querySelectorAll('.header-menu ul li');
let currentParent = null;
let currentSubMenu = null;

menuItems.forEach(item => {
const link = item.querySelector('a');
const text = link.textContent.trim();

if (text.startsWith('_')) {
// تنظيف النص من الشرطة السفلى
link.textContent = text.replace('_', '').trim();
// إذا لم تكن القائمة الفرعية موجودة، ننشئها
if (!currentSubMenu) {
currentSubMenu = document.createElement('ul');
currentSubMenu.classList.add('sub-menu');
if (currentParent) {
currentParent.appendChild(currentSubMenu);
currentParent.classList.add('has-children');
}
}
// نقل العنصر إلى القائمة الفرعية
currentSubMenu.appendChild(item);
} else {
// هذا عنصر رئيسي، نحفظه ليكون الأب للعناصر القادمة
currentParent = item;
currentSubMenu = null;
}
});
});
/*]]>*/
</script>

<script type='text/javascript'>
/*<![CDATA[*/
function initScoraFetcher(container) {
const label = container.getAttribute('data-label');
const maxResults = container.getAttribute('data-max') || 4;
const grid = container.querySelector('.single-grid');

if (!grid) return;

const callbackName = 'setupScoraGrid_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);

window[callbackName] = function(json) {
let html = '';
if (json.feed.entry) {
for (let i = 0; i < json.feed.entry.length; i++) {
let entry = json.feed.entry[i];
let title = entry.title.$t;
let postUrl = "";
for (let k = 0; k < entry.link.length; k++) {
if (entry.link[k].rel == 'alternate') {
postUrl = entry.link[k].href;
break;
}
}

let thumb = entry.media$thumbnail ? entry.media$thumbnail.url.replace('/s72-c/', '/s1600/') : 'https://placehold.jp/300x450.png';
let labels = entry.category || [];
let data = { category: "", type: "", country: "", language: "", year: "", quality: "" };

labels.forEach(lb => {
let term = lb.term;
if (term.includes('categories:')) data.category = term.split(':')[1];
if (term.includes('type:')) data.type = term.split(':')[1];
if (term.includes('country:')) data.country = term.split(':')[1];
if (term.includes('language:')) data.language = term.split(':')[1];
if (term.includes('year:')) data.year = term.split(':')[1];
if (term.includes('quality:')) data.quality = term.split(':')[1];
});

html += `
<div class="block">
<a href="${postUrl}" class="block-preview"></a>
<a href="${postUrl}" class="block-preview">
<img src="${thumb}" class="block-preview-image" alt="${title}">
<div class="over-layer">
<img src="${thumb}" class="block-preview-hover" alt="${title}">
</div>
</a>
<div class="block-retitle">
<a href="${postUrl}" class="block-link">
<h4 class="block-title">${title}</h4>
</a>
</div>
<div class="block-label">
${data.year ? `<a href="/search/label/year:${data.year}" class="block-label-year">${data.year}</a>` : ''}
${data.quality ? `<a href="/search/label/quality:${data.quality}" class="block-label-quality">${data.quality}</a>` : ''}
</div>
<div class="block-info">
<a href="${postUrl}" class="block-info-title">
<h4 class="block-info-title">${title}</h4>
</a>
<ul class="block-list">
<li class="block-item" id="block-category">
<span class="block-info-sutitle">التصنيف:</span>
<a href="/search/label/categories:${data.category}" class="block-info-link">${data.category}</a>
</li>
<li class="block-item" id="block-type">
<span class="block-info-sutitle">النوع:</span>
<a href="/search/label/type:${data.type}" class="block-info-link">${data.type}</a>
</li>
<li class="block-item" id="block-country">
<span class="block-info-sutitle">البلد:</span>
<a href="/search/label/country:${data.country}" class="block-info-link">${data.country}</a>
</li>
<li class="block-item" id="block-langyage">
<span class="block-info-sutitle">اللغة:</span>
<a href="/search/label/language:${data.language}" class="block-info-link">${data.language}</a>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>`;
}
}

$(grid).html(html);

// --- التعديل الجوهري هنا ---
// لا يتم تشغيل Owl Carousel إلا إذا كان الديف يمتلك الكلاس
if ($(grid).hasClass('owl-carousel')) {
$(grid).owlCarousel({
animateOut: 'fadeOut',
//center: true,
//margin: 15,
loop: true,
autoplaySpeed: 500,
dots: true,
dotsEach: true,
nav: false,
responsive: {
0: { items: 1, },
400: { items: 2,},
600: { items: 2,},
700: { items: 3,},
1000: { items: 4,},
1300: { items: 5,},
1400: { items: 5,},
1920: { items: 5 }
}
});

$(grid).find('.owl-dot').each(function() {
$(this).children('span').text($(this).index() + 1);
});
}
delete window[callbackName];
};

let script = document.createElement('script');
script.src = `/feeds/posts/default/-/${label}?alt=json-in-script&max-results=${maxResults}&callback=${callbackName}`;
document.body.appendChild(script);
}

$(document).ready(function() {
$('.scora-fetcher').each(function() {
initScoraFetcher(this);
});
});
/*]]>*/
</script>
<script type='text/javascript'>
/*<![CDATA[*/
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.single-tab-button');
const contentContainers = document.querySelectorAll('.single-tab-content');
const mainWrapper = document.querySelector('.single-tab-inner');

// 1. تخزين المحتوى في مصفوفة وحذفه من الصفحة لتخفيف الحمل
let tabsData = [];
contentContainers.forEach((container, index) => {
tabsData[index] = container.outerHTML;
container.remove();
});

// 2. دالة التبديل
tabButtons.forEach((button, index) => {
button.addEventListener('click', function() {
tabButtons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
this.classList.add('active');

// إظهار اللودر
mainWrapper.innerHTML = `
<div id="tab-loader" style="width:100%; text-align:center; padding:50px;">
<div class="loader-icon" style="color:#ff0055; font-size:30px;">
<lord-icon src="https://cdn.lordicon.com/flabvqvs.json" trigger="loop" state="loop-scale" style="width:50px;height:50px" colors="primary:#f70906"></lord-icon>
<p style="font-size:14px; margin-top:10px; color:#fff;">جاري التحميل...</p>
</div>
</div>`;

setTimeout(() => {
mainWrapper.innerHTML = tabsData[index];

// --- الجزء الجديد والمهم ---
// البحث عن وجود "scora-fetcher" داخل التاب الذي تم حقنه الآن
const fetcher = mainWrapper.querySelector('.scora-fetcher');
if (fetcher) {
// إذا وجدنا fetcher، نقوم باستدعاء الدالة التي تجلب الكروت يدوياً
// تأكد أن دالة جلب الكروت لديك اسمها (initScoraFetcher) أو ما شابه
if (typeof initScoraFetcher === "function") {
initScoraFetcher(fetcher);
} else {
// إذا كنت تستخدم الكود التلقائي، سنقوم بإعادة تشغيل المنطق هنا
console.log("جاري تشغيل جلب الكروت للتاب الحالي...");
triggerBloggerFetch(fetcher);
}
}
}, 800);
});
});

if (tabButtons[0]) tabButtons[0].click();
});

});

};

<script type='text/javascript'>
/*<![CDATA[*/
/**
* Blogger Dynamic Label Extractor
* بيسحب من الـ label-head ويوزع على الكروت تلقائياً
*/
const fixCardsData = () => {
const processCard = (card) => {
if (card.dataset.done === "true") return;

// 1. نجيب كل اللينكات اللي جوه label-head في الكارت ده
const labels = card.querySelectorAll('.label-head a');
// 2. خريطة الربط (المعرف : الكلمة المفتاحية في القسم)
const config = [
{ id: '#block-image-category', key: 'categories' },
{ id: '#block-image-type', key: 'type' },
{ id: '#block-image-country', key: 'country' },
{ id: '#block-image-langyage', key: 'language' },
{ id: '#block-image-year', key: 'year' },
{ id: '#block-image-quality', key: 'quality' }
];

labels.forEach(labelTag => {
const labelText = labelTag.textContent.trim(); // "quality:HD"
const labelHref = labelTag.href; // لينك القسم

config.forEach(item => {
if (labelText.toLowerCase().startsWith(item.key.toLowerCase() + ':')) {
// استخراج النص بعد النقطتين
const cleanValue = labelText.split(':')[1].trim();
// البحث عن العنصر الهدف جوه الكارت الحالي
const targetBox = card.querySelector(item.id);
if (targetBox) {
const targetLink = targetBox.tagName === 'A' ? targetBox : targetBox.querySelector('a');
if (targetLink) {
targetLink.textContent = cleanValue;
targetLink.href = labelHref; // اللينك الأصلي بتاع بلوجر
targetBox.style.display = 'inline-block';
}
}
}
});
});

// إخفاء الـ label-head الأصلي عشان شكله ميبوظش التصميم (اختياري)
const head = card.querySelector('.label-head');
if (head) head.style.display = 'none';

card.dataset.done = "true";
};

// مراقبة الكروت الجديدة (Infinite Scroll)
const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
mutations.forEach(mutation => {
mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
if (node.nodeType === 1) {
if (node.classList.contains('block-image')) processCard(node);
node.querySelectorAll('.block-image').forEach(processCard);
}
});
});
});

observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
// تشغيل للكروت الحالية
document.querySelectorAll('.block-image').forEach(processCard);
};

// التنفيذ
fixCardsData();
/*]]>*/
</script>
<script type='text/javascript'>
/*<![CDATA[*/
/**
* نظام بحث بلوجر الاحترافي - البحث اللحظي والفلترة الذكية
*/
const bloggerSearchSystem = () => {
const searchWrap = document.querySelector('.search-wrap');
const searchInput = document.querySelector('.gsc-input[name="q"]');
const searchSubmit = document.querySelector('.search-submit');
const filterMainBtn = document.querySelector('.search-filter-button');
const filterDropdown = document.querySelector('.search-filter-dropdown');
const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.search-filter-btn');
const resultsContainer = document.querySelector('.search-resultes');
let selectedFilter = 'all';
let typingTimer;

// --- 1. فتح وإغلاق قائمة الفلتر (إضافة كلاس active) ---
filterMainBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
e.stopPropagation();
filterDropdown.classList.toggle('active');
});

// إغلاق القائمة لو ضغطت في أي مكان بره
document.addEventListener('click', () => filterDropdown.classList.remove('active'));

// --- 2. التحكم في فتح/إغلاق البحث (Active Class على الـ Wrap) ---
searchSubmit.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
e.preventDefault();
searchWrap.classList.toggle('active');
if (searchInput.value.trim() !== "") executeSearch(searchInput.value.trim());
});

// --- 3. نظام اختيار الفلتر وتبديل النصوص ---
filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
filterBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
btn.classList.add('active');
// تغيير نص الزرار
filterMainBtn.innerHTML = `${btn.textContent} <i class="fa-solid fa-angle-down"></i>`;
// تحديد قيمة الفلتر
if (btn.id === 'search-filter-movies') selectedFilter = 'categories:افلام';
else if (btn.id === 'search-filter-series') selectedFilter = 'categories:مسلسلات';
else selectedFilter = 'all';
filterDropdown.classList.remove('active'); // إغلاق القائمة بعد الاختيار
if (searchInput.value.trim() !== "") executeSearch(searchInput.value.trim());
});
});

// --- 4. البحث اللحظي أثناء الكتابة (Debounce) ---
searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
clearTimeout(typingTimer);
const query = searchInput.value.trim();

if (query.length > 0) {
// إظهار اللودر فوراً
resultsContainer.innerHTML = `
<div class="search-loader" style="display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 20px;opacity: 1;visibility: visible;">
<lord-icon colors="primary:#dc0e30" src="https://cdn.lordicon.com/tewlfgbl.json" state="loop-line" style="width:50px;height:50px" trigger="loop"></lord-icon>
</div>`;
typingTimer = setTimeout(() => {
executeSearch(query);
}, 500); // يبحث بعد نصف ثانية من التوقف عن الكتابة
} else {
resultsContainer.innerHTML = '';
}
});

// --- 5. دالة جلب البيانات من بلوجر وتصفيتها ---
async function executeSearch(query) {
let searchQuery = query;
if (selectedFilter !== 'all') {
searchQuery = `${query} label:"${selectedFilter}"`;
}

const feedUrl = `/feeds/posts/default?alt=json&q=${encodeURIComponent(searchQuery)}&max-results=8`;

try {
const response = await fetch(feedUrl);
const data = await response.json();
const entries = data.feed.entry;

resultsContainer.innerHTML = ''; // مسح اللودر

if (entries && entries.length > 0) {
entries.forEach(entry => {
resultsContainer.innerHTML += renderCard(entry);
});

// زر عرض المزيد
const fullSearchLink = `/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(searchQuery)}`;
resultsContainer.innerHTML += `
<div class="search-more-wrap" style="text-align:center; padding: 20px;">
<a href="${fullSearchLink}" class="search-view-more">عرض كل النتائج</a>
</div>`;
} else {
const filterName = filterMainBtn.textContent.trim();
resultsContainer.innerHTML = `
<div class="search-no-results" style="padding:20px; text-align:center;">
عذراً، لا توجد نتائج لـ "${query}" في قسم ${filterName}.
</div>`;
}
} catch (error) {
resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="search-error">حدث خطأ في الاتصال.</div>';
}
}

// --- 6. بناء الكارت (قالب block-image الخاص بك) ---
function renderCard(entry) {
const title = entry.title.$t;
const link = entry.link.find(l => l.rel === 'alternate').href;
const img = entry.media$thumbnail ? entry.media$thumbnail.url.replace('s72-c', 's1600') : 'placeholder.jpg';
return `
<div class="block-image">
<div class="block-image-details">
<h2 class="post-title entry-title"><a href="${link}">${title}</a></h2>
</div>
<a class="thumb" href="${link}">
<img src="${img}" class="Half1" alt="${title}">
<div class="thumb-hover"><img src="${img}" class="Half2" alt="${title}"></div>
</a>
<font class="retitle"><span class="post-retitle"><h2 class="post-title">${title}</h2></span></font>
</div>`;
}
};

// تشغيل النظام
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bloggerSearchSystem);
/*]]>*/
</script>

<script type='text/javascript'>
/*<![CDATA[*/
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
const filters = {
'categories': document.getElementById('filter-categories'),
'type': document.getElementById('filter-type'),
'year': document.getElementById('filter-year'),
'country': document.getElementById('filter-country'),
'language': document.getElementById('filter-language'),
'quality': document.getElementById('filter-quality')
};

const loader = document.querySelector('.post-grid-loader');
const activeFilters = { categories: null, type: null, year: null, country: null, language: null, quality: null };
const labelSet = new Set();

// --- 1. فتح وإغلاق القوائم ---
document.querySelectorAll('.filter-button').forEach(btn => {
btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
e.stopPropagation();
const dropdown = btn.nextElementSibling;
document.querySelectorAll('.filter-dropdown').forEach(d => { if(d !== dropdown) d.classList.remove('active') });
dropdown.classList.toggle('active');
});
});
document.addEventListener('click', () => document.querySelectorAll('.filter-dropdown').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('active')));

// --- 2. سحب الأقسام من الكروت وملء القوائم تلقائياً ---
const updateDropdowns = () => {
const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.block-image');
cards.forEach(card => {
const labels = card.querySelectorAll('.label-head a');
labels.forEach(label => {
const fullText = label.textContent.trim();
if (!labelSet.has(fullText)) {
labelSet.add(fullText);
const [key, value] = fullText.split(':');
const targetDropdown = filters[key.toLowerCase()];
if (targetDropdown && value) {
const btn = document.createElement('button');
btn.className = 'filter-dropdown-btn';
btn.type = 'button';
btn.innerHTML = `${value} <span class="filter-circle"></span>`;
btn.dataset.filterKey = key.toLowerCase();
btn.dataset.filterValue = fullText;

btn.addEventListener('click', () => handleFilterClick(btn, value, fullText, key.toLowerCase()));
targetDropdown.appendChild(btn);
}
}
});
});
};

// --- 3. معالجة الضغط على قسم للفلترة ---
const handleFilterClick = (btn, cleanValue, fullValue, key) => {
const parentBox = btn.closest('.filter-box');
const filterText = parentBox.querySelector('.filter-text');
btn.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.filter-dropdown-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
btn.classList.add('active');
filterText.textContent = cleanValue;
activeFilters[key] = fullValue === 'all' ? null : fullValue;

applyFilter();
};

// --- 4. تطبيق الفلترة على post-grid-item ---
const applyFilter = () => {
if(loader) {
loader.style.opacity = '1';
loader.style.visibility = 'visible';
}

setTimeout(() => {
// هنا التعديل: بنجيب الـ item الكبير
const gridItems = document.querySelectorAll('.post-grid-item');
gridItems.forEach(item => {
// بنجيب الداتا من الـ block-image اللي جوه الـ item
const card = item.querySelector('.block-image');
if (!card) return;

const cardLabels = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('.label-head a')).map(a => a.textContent.trim());
let isMatch = true;
for (const key in activeFilters) {
if (activeFilters[key] && !cardLabels.includes(activeFilters[key])) {
isMatch = false;
break;
}
}

// التعديل الأساسي: الإخفاء للأب الكبير
item.style.display = isMatch ? 'block' : 'none';
});

if(loader) {
loader.style.opacity = '0';
loader.style.visibility = 'hidden';
}
}, 400);
};

// --- 5. مراقبة الـ Infinite Scroll ---
const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
updateDropdowns();
if (Object.values(activeFilters).some(v => v !== null)) {
applyFilter();
}
});

observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

updateDropdowns();

document.querySelectorAll('.filter-dropdown-btn').forEach(btn => {
if(btn.textContent.includes('الكل')) {
btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
const key = btn.parentElement.id.replace('filter-', '');
handleFilterClick(btn, 'بدون إختيار', 'all', key);
});
}
});
});
/*]]>*/
</script>
<script type='text/javascript'>
/*<![CDATA[*/
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

filterButtons.forEach(btn => {

// 1. لو عاوز زرار واحد بس اللي يكون active في المرة الواحدة (تبديل)

<script type='text/javascript'>
/*<![CDATA[*/
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
// التأكد إن الضغطة حصلت على زرار مشاركة أو أيقونة جواه
const shareBtn = e.target.closest('.single-share-link');
if (!shareBtn) return;

e.preventDefault();

const id = shareBtn.id;
const postUrl = encodeURIComponent(window.location.href);
const postTitle = encodeURIComponent(document.title);

let url = '';

// بناء الرابط حسب الـ ID
switch (id) {
case 'single-share-facebook':
url = `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${postUrl}`;
break;
case 'single-share-twitter':
url = `https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=${postTitle}&url=${postUrl}`;
break;
case 'single-share-telegram':
url = `https://t.me/share/url?url=${postUrl}&text=${postTitle}`;
break;
case 'single-share-whatsapp':
url = `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=${postTitle}%20${postUrl}`;
break;
case 'single-share-massenger':
url = `fb-messenger://share/?link=${postUrl}`;
break;
}

if (url) {
const width = 600;
const height = 450;
const left = (window.innerWidth / 2) - (width / 2);
const top = (window.innerHeight / 2) - (height / 2);

window.open(url, 'share-popup', `width=${width},height=${height},top=${top},left=${left},scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes`);
}
});
/*]]>*/
</script>
<script type='text/javascript'>
/*<![CDATA[*/
(function() {
const domain = window.location.hostname;
const currentUrl = window.location.href;
let shortUrlCache = "";

// 1. جلب الرابط المختصر فوراً وتخزينه
fetch(`https://tinyurl.com/api-create.php?url=${encodeURIComponent(currentUrl)}`)
.then(res => res.text())
.then(data => { shortUrlCache = data.replace('https://', ''); });

// 2. "المحرك الإجباري": بيراقب التابة وأول ما تظهر يلطشها بالرابط
const forceFix = () => {
const el = document.querySelector('.single-short-text');
if (el) {
const finalLink = shortUrlCache || (domain + "/?p=" + (document.body.className.match(/itemid-(\d+)/)?.[1] || ""));
if (el.textContent.trim() !== finalLink && shortUrlCache !== "") {
el.textContent = finalLink;
}
}
};

// مراقبة الدوم + فحص دوري سريع جداً عشان نغلب الـ Render بتاع التابة
setInterval(forceFix, 100);
new MutationObserver(forceFix).observe(document.documentElement, {childList: true, subtree: true});

// 3. زرار النسخ - شغال بنظام الـ "Global Listener" عشان ميفصلش
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
const btn = e.target.closest('.single-short-button');
if (!btn) return;
e.preventDefault();
const text = document.querySelector('.single-short-text').textContent.trim();
const input = document.createElement("input");
document.body.appendChild(input);
input.value = "https://" + text;
input.select();
document.execCommand("copy");
document.body.removeChild(input);

const icon = btn.querySelector('i');
icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-check';
setTimeout(() => { icon.className = 'fa-regular fa-copy'; }, 1500);
});
})();
/*]]>*/
</script>
